fields.Name: T235 - Chat Workspace Load and Tab Chrome
fields.Description: Exercises ConversationWorkspaceComponent bootstrap including the isWorkspaceReady agent-preload gate and the three-tab navigation chrome — a code path no generic dashboard or entity grid touches.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the 'Chat' application. Wait for the conversations workspace to finish initializing (it shows a 'Loading agents...' spinner first). Confirm the workspace chrome renders: a top navigation bar with three tabs labeled 'Chats', 'Collections', and 'Tasks', a left sidebar containing a 'New Conversation' button, and either a conversation chat area or a welcome/empty state on the right. Seeing this three-tab workspace render is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Chat application opens and its workspace finishes loading past the 'Loading agents...' spinner
The top navigation shows three tabs: Chats, Collections, and Tasks
A 'New Conversation' button is visible in the left sidebar and the main area shows a chat/empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
